These are some notes on domains with conditional effects + quantified variables.
x is the parameters of action(x)
3*(x,y) indicates that there are 3 conjunctive terms in the condition, parameterized by the x and quantified variable y

-----------------
satellite
- when (x) -> (x) [trivial condition; got compiled out in pddl_generator]
briefcase
- forall y when 1*(y) -> (x,y)
citycar
- forall y when 1*(x,y) -> (x,y)
maintenance
- forall y when (x,y) -> (y)
miconic-simpleadl
- forall y when 2*(x,y) -> (y)
nurikabe
- forall y when 2*(x,y) -> (y)
- forall y when 2*(x,y) -> (x,y)


schedule
- when 1*(x) -> (x) [trivial condition]
- forall y when 1*(x,y) -> (x,y) [trivial condition]
- forall y,z when 1*(x,y,z) -> (x,y,z) [trivial condition]
- forall y when 1*(y) -> (y) [trivial condition]
spider
- when 1*(x) -> (x)
- when 1*(x) -> ()
spider-axioms
- derived: not-exists y when (x,y)
- derived: exists y when (x,y)
- forall y when 1*(x,y) -> (y)
- forall y,z,w when 3*(x,y,z,w) -> (x,y)
- forall y,z when 2*([x,y]-[y,z]) -> (y,z)
- forall y,z when 2*([x,y]-[y,z]) -> (y,constant)

trucks
> forall y ((x,y) implies (x,y))
    > not-exists y when (x,y)
fridge
> exists y,z when 3*([x,y],[y,z])
> exists y when (x,y) + not-exists z when (y,z)
miconic-fulladl
> conflict-a/conflict-b: stupidly hard preconditions
> never-alone/attendant: stupidly hard preconditions
> going_nonstop: not-exists y when (x,y)
> no-access: not-exists y when (x,y)
> vip: (not-exists y when (y)) or (exists y when (x,y)) or (exists y when (x,y))
> not-exists y when
- forall y when 2*(x,y) -> (y)
cave-diving-adl
- forall y when 1*(x,y) -> (y)
assembly: (extremely challenging)
> forall y ((x,y) implies (x,y))
    > not-exists y when (x,y) [equivalent form]
> (x) or (x)
> ((x) and (forall y ((x,y) implies (x,y))) or ((x) and (not-exists y when 2*(x,y))
    > ((x) and (not-exists y when 2*(x,y))) or ... [equivalent form]
- (not-exists y when 2*(x,y)) and (not-exists z when 2*(x,z)) -> (x) [EQVs not in effect]
